stage.name: Moongolow
stage.spawn_type: Standard: enemies approach from all four sides of the player
stage.modifiers_note: Bonus stage (unlocked via hyper mode on four normal stages), 15:00 limit. Wiki infobox: luck shown as '-' (treated as x1). enemy_speed 1.35 is a multiplier not applied to enemy file speeds. Wiki stage id is SINKING; this project uses MOONGOLOW. Hyper mode not needed.
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Periodic spawning stops while 300 or more enemies are alive; only bosses and map-event enemies can still spawn (Map event page).
stage.spawn_rule: Each minute's wave has a minimum enemy count and a spawn interval. If alive count < minimum, spawn until the quota is filled; otherwise spawn one of each enemy type in the wave per interval. Bosses are teleported back onto screen rather than despawned.
stage.map_event_chance_rule: Event chance is divided by player Luck (chanceWithLuck = eventChance / totalLuck); evaluated per repeat; no chance or 0 means guaranteed.
stage.eclipse_note: The wiki lists Eclipse wave variants at 12:00-14:00 (Small Eyeball / Eyeball / Giant Eyeball, Moon Trinacria boss, Cry event with 120 eyes) that only occur for eligible characters. Not modelled; the Normal variant rows are used for waves and bosses.

stage_items.passives_note: 16 unique non-DLC passives (all except Torrona's Box, Parm Aegis, Karoma's Mana), one of each guaranteed, on the floor around the spawn; Milky Way Map shows them.

stage.destructibles: Moon Anforas (see special_mechanics) plus standard light sources (30% chance, max 10).

layout.size_note: Not stated on the wiki. Sunken-city ruins; the four passive-item clusters sit NE/SE/SW/NW of the start, the four Yellow Sign relics N/E/S/W further out. Distances unknown.
layout.obstacles: Sparse: ruined walls/pillars of a drowned city with mostly open ground (details not on the wiki; estimate).
layout.theme: Sunken city under a full moon: pale blue sea-ruins, drowned stone streets, moonlit water tones; background turns red during the Lunar Eclipse variant.
special_mechanics: Extra stage items: 16 passive items (4 clusters of 4 around the start: SW Hollow Heart/Pummarola/Armor/Wings; NE Spinach/Bracer/Spellbinder/Candelabrador; SE Empty Tome/Duplicator/Tiragisu/Attractorb; NW Clover/Crown/Stone Mask/Skull O'Maniac), one of each guaranteed.
Merchant always present (sells Glass Vizard); Healer and Eggman NPCs present; Xanthia only with DLC.
Moon Anfora clusters: every 10 s up to 18 amphoras (6 x Luck) spawn just off screen; each drops a Gold Coin auto-collected; despawn cap 100, teleported back to screen edge when far.
Jellyfish and Sneaky Heads are Fixed Direction: they cross the screen (jellyfish vertically, heads horizontally) in wavy patterns instead of chasing.
Moon Guardians (14:00) drop a Golden Egg; Reaper at 15:00, then one more per minute.

map_events.map_events_note: Moongolow has no periodic map events in the Normal wave table; only the Eclipse-only Cry event exists (120 Unknown 1S eyes circling the player at 14:00).

unsupported_events.wiki_description: Cry: large amount of eyes circling the player at a set distance plus Moon Trinacria; defeating Moon Trinacria transports the player to Holy Forbidden. Only for Lunar Eclipse characters; not used.

unsupported_events_note: Only the eclipse-variant Cry event; ignored.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 15:00 (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

light_sources.spawn_chance: 30% base (stage), multiplied by Luck, capped at 60%
light_sources.spawn_location: predetermined possible spawn locations in this stage (Light source page); Mad Forest spawns them in an oval around the player
light_sources.cap_behaviour: when at cap, a new spawn appears nearest the player and the oldest despawns

rosary.effect: kills all enemies (on screen) that are not immune to instant kill; bosses/Reaper resistant

orologion.effect: freezes all enemies for 10 seconds; frozen enemies do not move or damage the player and can be pushed by walking into them; newly spawned enemies also freeze

vacuum.effect: pulls all Experience Gems on the ground to the player; ignores other pickups; takes time to arrive

nduja.effect: player breathes fire in facing direction for 10 s (damage 30, cooldown 0.5s, interval 0.04s per weapon table)
